test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word-substitute for the given group of words.

__A false idea or belief__
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Fallacy is the correct answer, as it refers to a false idea or belief.

Hence, the correct answer is 'Option 3'.

Example Sentence: Believing money buys happiness is a fallacy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Reticence refers to being reserved or restrained, especially in speech, and is unrelated to a false idea.
 
• Atrophy means the wasting away or decline of body tissue or skills, not relevant to the given context.
 
• Entropy is a measure of disorder or randomness, primarily in thermodynamics, not applicable here.
